title: Aa Gaye Asghar Bhi Run Mein Deen Bachanay Kay Liye
body:
Ambia Ka Main Hu Nasir (x2)
Yeh Batanay Kay Liye
<<DIVIDER>>
Hurmula Teri Kama Ko Taud Kay Rakh Dounga Main (x2)
Aaya Huun Main Naam Tera (x2)
Hi Mitanay Kay Liye
<<DIVIDER>>
Jab Kama Hurmal Ki Dekhi Boli Khaimon Say Rubab (x2)
Ab Raho Taiyar Asghar (x2)
Teer Khanay Kay Liye
<<DIVIDER>>
Hashr Tak Karti Rahay Gi Intezar Umme Rubab (x2)
Gaud Main Jhuulay Kay Aadhi (x2)
Ko Jhoolanay Kay Liye
<<DIVIDER>>
Tha Kayamat Ka Sama Muntaz Pyason Ki Vo Shaam (x2)
Aagaye Zahra Kay Ghar Ko (x2)
Phir Jaalanay Kay Liye
